'''Caretaker Probe droid''', also known as '''Sporefall Monitor''' or '''Sporogenic Probe''', was a model of an [[Environmental droid|environmental]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utilized by automatic systems of the ''[[Jannimak]]'', a [[Research vessel|bio-research vessel]] built to accommodate a wide range of exotic species.<ref name="wreckage">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Wreckage on Dantooine|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> After the [[Crash of the Jannimak|''Jannimak''{{'s}} crash]] around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> these droids were deployed by the ship to take care of the survived creatures, take readings that would provide feedback to the ''Jannimak''{{'s}} [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] process<ref name="acid trip">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Acid Trip|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> and fight off [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]]'s researchers and contractors, whom the ship's AI deemed an obstacle in the terraforming effort.<ref name="watchers">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|The Watchers|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

Several Caretaker droids defended [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Spears]], when under the influence of poisonous [[Fungus/Legends|spores]] he was fighting against [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]].<ref name="SPORES">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|They Call me Doctor Spores|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

An advanced subtype of a Caretaker Probe droid, referred to as the [[Spore-Tending Unit]], was another model utilized by the ''Jannimak''{{'s}} systems.<ref name="sporefall">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Sporefall]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>
